//: Shared Claude Code settings for this repo, committed on purpose so a second machine behaves the same as the first and nobody has to rebuild an allowlist by hand. Personal additions go in .claude/settings.local.json, which stays gitignored.

permissions.//allow: Routine and reversible. Approving them once here saves a prompt in every session.
permissions.//deny: Refused outright rather than asked about, because each one destroys something a session cannot put back and the right answer is a person doing it deliberately. db:reset and db:restore replace the local database; db:pull-prod overwrites local with a copy of production and is fine on purpose but never mid-task; the git entries throw away uncommitted work or rewrite the remote.
